goal: How many running activities did I do this week in the OpenTracks app? Assume the week starts from Monday. Express your answer as a single integer.
summary:
I answered **2**, but it's a best guess. I counted by matching the icons in the track list, without opening any track to check its category.

From Monday Oct 9 to Sunday Oct 15, two tracks have the running-figure icon:
- "Trying and failing to keep up with John" (yesterday)
- "Active Rest Day" (Friday)

The other tracks that week have walking, cycling, skiing, climbing or skateboard icons. Two of them, "Trail Hike" and "Hill Walk", look like walking, so I left them out. The two runs below Monday are from Oct 6, outside the week.

One thing doesn't fit: the all-time stats show 3 running tracks, but the list shows 4 with the running icon. So that icon may cover more than one category, possibly "trail running". If one of this week's two is trail running, the true count would be 1. I didn't set the stats date filter to this week, which would have confirmed it.
